items.headline: $DOOD Explodes 212% as Doodles Token Hits $38M Cap
items.summary: Doodles' $DOOD surged 212% to a $38M market cap with $213M in 24h volume, while the NFT floor climbed 7.4% in ETH terms.

items.headline: $DATALINE ICO Coming After $10.6M AI Data Raise
items.summary: Dataline raised $10.6M for its decentralized data network for AI agents and plans a public $DATALINE token sale via Uniswap's auction platform, details due next week.

items.headline: $DOGE Gets Serious: Dogecoin Labs Launches for DeFi Push
items.summary: Dogecoin Labs, backed by the Dogecoin Foundation, unites MyDoge, DogeOS and Such App to push $DOGE beyond memes into payments and DeFi.

items.headline: $CAKE 'Flip' Vote Opens With 69% Emissions Cut
items.summary: PancakeSwap opened 'The Flip' governance vote, keeping $CAKE buybacks from non-stablecoin fees while phasing a ~69% cut in daily emissions.

items.headline: $DOT Alert: Fearless Wallet Private-Key Leak
items.summary: Polkadot warned Fearless Wallet users to move funds after a private-key leak; an affected Chrome extension version with 6,000 users was still listed.
